findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract members: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the newly added build_occurrence_and_event_data. Python will raise TypeError when Detector.detector_handler tries to instantiate this class for a metric_alert_fire detector, and process_detectors does not handle that exception, so processing can abort instead of being skipped. Previously this handler was a concrete no-op whose evaluate() returned []. The subclass needs stub implementations of the abstract methods, or it should remain a DetectorHandler until the stateful implementation is available.
